about: Predicted minutes per full-mutation lane on int21h-ws: calibration x baseline x (fixed_share + (1 - fixed_share) x the product of the speed factors). Read by TestFullMutationUnitsAreBalancedFromTheLaneTable. Raw inputs: artifacts 012/inputs.md of the run that wrote it.
baseline_about: Minutes per lane on #235's times (the Jenkinsfile's balance comment before this table): the only per-lane split that survives, as Jenkins no longer holds the consoles of main 265, 271 and 272.
calibration_about: Unit totals on main 265: 90.6/95.6/102.5, main 271: 107.4/100.3/105.6, main 272: all three cut at 110.5 (PRD results table), against the old table's heaviest unit of 96: 110.5/96 = 1.15, the conservative end.
fixed_share_about: Share of a lane's minutes that does not scale with test time (compiling and linking each mutant's test binary, gremlins' work copies). An assumption, to be re-measured by task 014's EXTENDED+MUTATION_FULL build.
